dataset.stored_preprocessing: HME default: Hann window then L2 normalization

query_modes.native: normalize corrupted raw vector, matching the existing HME API
query_modes.symmetric: apply the same Hann window to corrupted raw vector, then normalize

dataset.split: No fitting or tuning. All ten registered seeds are evaluation replicates; correctness fixtures use other seeds and smaller arrays.

arm_definitions.hme: Unmodified HMEEngine default ranker, salience off, relevance threshold zero.
arm_definitions.nn_cosine: Exact signed cosine over copies of the exact processed vectors retained by HME; stable insertion-order ties.
arm_definitions.nn_absolute: Exact absolute cosine over the same processed vectors; stable insertion-order ties.
arm_definitions.hme_field_erased: Deep copy of HME with only the memory field zeroed. Records, cached vectors, patterns, metadata and lineage retained.

protocol.side_information: All records and queries use the same position. All arms retain identical artifact records and lineage. No target ID is passed to a search method. No tags, IDs or metadata are used to select a target.

budget.policy: Same candidate set and same maximum persistent storage cap, not artificial padding to equal consumption. NN keeps copies of HME records and lineage for equal provenance service. Record actual consumption; do not infer an equal-byte capacity frontier.
budget.accounting: Recursive CPython getsizeof over each arm's reachable owned object graph, including arrays/bases, cached patterns, field, records and lineage; count object aliases once. Also report unique retained numeric array bytes. Excludes interpreter, shared code/libraries, allocator overhead and transient query workspace.

primary.advantage_rule: Both arms must fit the common cap, and the lower endpoint of the paired-seed 95% bootstrap interval must exceed +0.02. Otherwise this experiment does not support the registered practical-advantage claim.
primary.worse_rule: An upper endpoint below zero supports lower HME accuracy in this registered condition. Other non-passing outcomes are inconclusive for the practical-advantage claim.

secondary.conditions: All registered noise levels and both query modes; contrasts with absolute NN and field-erased HME are descriptive mechanism checks.
secondary.unmatched_queries: Fresh Gaussian vectors with no designated stored target, not a distribution-shift test. Report acceptance/false-acceptance fraction at default policies; no calibrated rejection claim.
secondary.field_only_check: One fresh query per seed after records and cached vectors/patterns are removed, field retained. Report hit count and decoded surface norm; this is a structural check, not an identity-retrieval arm.

statistics.unit: Independent dataset/noise seed; do not treat queries sharing a field as independent replicates.
statistics.interval: Two-sided 2.5/97.5 percentile bootstrap over ten paired seed-level metrics.
statistics.multiplicity: One confirmatory primary comparison. All other intervals are descriptive, without multiplicity adjustment; no subgroup may replace the primary.
statistics.zero_variance: Zero-width intervals when all ten values agree describe the observed seeds and do not prove perfect population performance.

latency.measurement: perf_counter_ns around one online search call, including query preprocessing. Rotate arm order by (query index + repetition) modulo four. Summarize per-seed median and p95; report paired HME/NN median ratios. HME's public API also computes reconstructed outputs, which NN does not supply. No intrinsic algorithmic-speed claim.

protocol.stopping: Run all ten seeds and every registered cell once. No early stopping, seed replacement, parameter tuning or outcome-driven exclusions. On a technical failure, retain an explicit failure record; any fix must be documented and committed before a complete rerun, with the original registration preserved.
protocol.prior_information: Existing HME-only audits at other seeds informed the choice of noise levels. No nearest-neighbor outcomes on the registered seeds have been inspected before registration.
excluded_claims: Effectiveness of optional field controllers or salience
protocol.registration: Push protocol, evaluator and correctness fixtures to GitHub before running registered seeds. Pass that public commit to --registration-commit. Evaluator verifies frozen protocol, evaluator, tests and engine bytes via git show and records source/data hashes. Preserve the registration commit in history.
